3 حارض , (Ibn-'Abbád,) inf. n. مُحَارَضَةٌ, (Ibn- 'Abbád, K,) He contended with another in shuffling, or playing with, gaming-arrows. (Ibn- 'Abbád, K.) [See حُرْضَةٌ.] ＝
-A2- حارض عَلَى العَمَلِ, (Lh,) inf. n. as above, (Lh, K,) He applied himself constantly, or perseveringly, to work: (Lh, K:) and على القِتَالِ to fight. (Lh.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
